assessment: The proposal is scientifically defensible. (1) Coverage: all four notebook scientific endpoints (hrv_time, hrv_freq, hrv_nonlinear, hrv as combined table) are preserved with verbatim source evidence; excluded items (raw recording, peaks vector, show=True plots) are intermediates/plot-only, matching `inputs/plan.json` on every cell. The n=1 population is preserved — ecg_peaks runs on the identical bytes of the original dataset entry-point. (2) Solver inference target: the task asks for the well-defined default HRV index sets of a named pinned reference procedure ("The reference pipeline is the standard, default HRV computation of NeuroKit2 version 0.2.13"), with the empty-cell semantics for multi-minute-only indices matching the recorded reference. All consequential defaults claimed in the brief were independently verified against wheel source: hrv() concat at defaults with no RSA branch for DataFrame peaks; ulf/vlf/lf/hf/vhf = 0–0.0033/0.0033–0.04/0.04–0.15/0.15–0.4/0.4–0.5; psd_method='welch'; interpolation_rate=100; normalize=True (identical to the notebook's explicit argument); ecg_peaks defaults method='neurokit', correct_artifacts=False on the raw ECG. Alignment by column name rather than file order is the right identity rule. (3) The prompt does not disclose private reference values, names NeuroKit2 0.2.13 as the public definition, and requires faithful recomputation rather than guessing. (4) The candidate's nk.data('/inputs/https/...') path hack is construction-side routing only, not reflected in the solver-facing contract (validation_handoff deliberately moves to a direct local path). (5) The handoff is upfront that tolerances are pending empirical calibration, distinguishing representation differences from quantity differences; tolerance calibration is executable validation and not a proposal-stage target-definition problem. No source- or proposal-level conflict affecting the task definition was found.
